title: Smart batteries: materials, monitoring, and artificial intelligence
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, 54,10006-10139
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00609K, Review Article
Nan Zhang, Tianyi Hou, Gaoce Han, Yifei Yu, Henghui Xu, Yunhui Huang
This review proposes a novel concept for smart batteries called 4S paradigm, including four dimensions: stable, safe, sustainable, and sensible, which is realized by the use of responsive materials, monitoring and AI-based management technologies.
